d1_out=[[2,2,6,2],[8,8,6,6],[2,2,6,8],[8,8,8,6]]
def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid); h=len(grid[0])
    coords=[]
    for r in range(n-3):
        for c in range(h-3):
            if all(grid[i][j]==3 for i in range(r,r+4) for j in range(c,c+4)):
                coords.append((r,c))
    r,c=coords[0]
    rr=n-4-r; cc=h-4-c
    return [list(reversed(grid[rr+3-i][cc:cc+4])) for i in range(4)]
